issues.description: The problem statement (line describing the task) specifies addGuestStudents(String) while the UML and the solution implement addGuestStudents(int). This parameter type mismatch (String vs int) can confuse students about the expected parameter type and what they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement to request addGuestStudents(int) (an integer parameter) to match the UML diagram and the solution implementation. Alternatively, if a String parameter was intended, update the UML and solution to use String and include guidance on parsing/validation.
